consulting_peers.asset: Supply Chain AI by BCG X + BCG Operations Supply Chain Management
consulting_peers.winning_story: BCG X publishes direct operations transformation stories, including AI-enabled modernization of a large integrated iron-ore supply chain and resilience-focused supply-chain redesign in food service, indicating strong consulting-to-execution capability.

tech_giants.solution: Amazon Connect Decisions (next generation of AWS Supply Chain)
tech_giants.advantage: Native agentic planning with item-level demand intelligence and 24/7 supply intelligence; direct customer evidence cites nearly 40% forecast-accuracy improvement, 90% forecasting automation, and 7% inventory reduction with improved fill rate.

tech_giants.solution: Google Cloud Supply Chain & Logistics data/AI stack
tech_giants.advantage: Direct customer stories show agentic AI applied to retail and food-service operations, including measurable productivity and conversion gains tied to data-and-AI-enabled planning and execution workflows.

tech_giants.solution: Dynamics 365 + autonomous agents across ERP and supply-chain processes
tech_giants.advantage: Tight ERP/process integration with broad enterprise footprint and rapid Copilot/agent rollout across business workflows, lowering adoption friction for existing Microsoft estates.

cots_vendors.name: SAP IBP
cots_vendors.focus: End-to-end cloud planning (S&OP, demand sensing, response/supply, DDMRP, inventory planning) with SAP ecosystem integration.
cots_vendors.gap_vs_us: Broader packaged planning scope and mature enterprise integrations may exceed PFEP/IVO breadth, but can require heavier transformation effort than a PFEP-focused deployment.

cots_vendors.name: Oracle Supply Chain Planning
cots_vendors.focus: Fusion cloud planning with AI/ML forecasting, replenishment, production scheduling, and S&OP; recognized as 2026 Gartner MQ Leader for SCP Discrete Industries.
cots_vendors.gap_vs_us: Stronger out-of-the-box cross-functional planning depth and analyst validation; PFEP/IVO advantage is potentially faster part-level standardization in constrained manufacturing contexts.

cots_vendors.name: LeanDNA
cots_vendors.focus: Discrete-manufacturing inventory optimization and supply planning with ERP augmentation and execution-oriented control-tower patterns.
cots_vendors.gap_vs_us: Directly competes on part-level execution and shows strong manufacturing ROI proof points, reducing PFEP/IVO differentiation unless unique IP moat is explicit.

pros: PFEP/IVO is tightly aligned to part-level governance and standardization, which is often a practical first value wedge in industrial product environments.
Consulting-to-code potential: can embed enterprise-specific planning rules, data semantics, and operational playbooks faster than full-suite replacement.
Likely lower initial ownership burden for targeted PFEP outcomes compared with broad COTS transformation programs.
cons: Moat risk: without proprietary optimization IP and benchmarked ROI, the asset can be perceived as a wrapper around dashboarding and workflow layers.
Scale risk versus hyperscaler-native and COTS platforms that already package agentic planning, broad integrations, and global references.
Evidence gap: fewer publicly verifiable, quantified outcomes than top-tier peers and COTS leaders.
functional_gaps: Agentic planning copilots for autonomous exception triage, recommendation execution, and closed-loop learning at item/part granularity.
Enterprise-grade digital thread from PFEP master data to procurement, production, inventory, and logistics execution with end-to-end traceability.
Benchmark-backed value cockpit with auditable KPI baselines (inventory, shortages, OTD, working capital) and realized benefit tracking by site and value stream.

improvement_roadmap: Productize a proprietary part-level optimization engine (policy simulation + scenario AI + execution recommendations) and expose it as reusable IP rather than project logic.
Release an industrial integration accelerator for SAP/Oracle/Microsoft ERP plus MES/WMS signals to reduce implementation time and prove lower total ownership cost.

Build an evidence program with lighthouse clients and independently auditable outcomes (for example inventory reduction, shortage reduction, and OTD uplift) to establish a defensible market narrative.
